title: State Bank of India v. N. Sundara Money

content.caseIdentity: State Bank of India v. N. Sundara Money, (1976) 1 SCC 822
content.facts: The Court examined termination and the statutory meaning of retrenchment.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether termination falling outside the employer's stated reason may amount to retrenchment.
content.ratioDecidendi: Retrenchment receives a broad meaning subject to the statutory exceptions and conditions precedent.
content.holding: The Court applied the protective scheme to the termination in question.
content.relevance: Use for IDA s. 2(oo) and s. 25F analysis.

evidence.note: 3-Judge Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 984 of 1975; 1976 INSC 4; (1976) 1 SCC 822; 1976 (3) SCR 160.
